name: flight-ofp-tool
description: Flight prep / OFP generator companion for Infinite Flight, RFS, and MSFS. Static site, no build step needed to run the tool itself.
note: jsdom is ONLY needed to run tests/integration.test.mjs locally (it polyfills DOMParser so fpl-import.js can be tested in Node). The actual tool never uses it — engine/fpl-import.js relies on the browser's native DOMParser at runtime.
